findings.evidence: Reasoned. IdentityProviderBean.java:226 uses getLoginPredicate() as its base filter. findings.claim: update() decides whether to skip login-cache invalidation using a 'before' model from getById(), which is org-aware wrapped and reports isEnabled()==false while its organization is disabled. The method then returns early (lines 403-407) without invalidating. After the org is re-enabled, the cached ORG_ONLY/ALL lists still contain the IdP and the login page shows it.
findings.evidence: Reasoned, not run. original comes from getById (line 91), wrapped by createOrganizationAwareIdentityProviderModel (lines 430-445). updated is a plain model from IdentityProviderResource.updateIdpFromRep → RepresentationToModel.toModel (line 191). findings.claim: The ORG_ONLY and ALL login caches hold a single IdentityProviderListQuery entry per realm and FetchMode, keyed internally by org id. Every first-seen org invalidates the entry and copies the whole previous map (O(#orgs) per miss). The entry grows without bound, concurrent misses bump the revision so addRevisioned keeps failing under load, and any login-IdP change discards results for all orgs.
findings.evidence: Reasoned. See lines 215 and 232-241. The IdentityProviderListQuery copy constructor does putAll(previous.searchKeys). By contrast, getByOrganization uses one key per org. Suggested alternative: key by realm + mode + orgId.
